hero.headline: EVERY CENT, ON THE RECORD.
hero.sub: Give to people and charities you can check. Your donation waits in a locked account and is paid out in steps, only after donors approve the receipts.

howItWorks.title: How it works

donate.title: You donate
donate.body: By card, Apple Pay or crypto wallet. You get an email receipt and a link to follow your money.

milestones.title: The money is locked
milestones.body: It waits in a locked account. Nobody, including us, can send it anywhere except the campaign, back to donors, or the Emergency Pool.

proof.title: Donors approve, money moves
proof.body: Charities get the money in 3 steps. Each next step is paid only after donors approve the receipts for the last one.

howItWorks.belowNote: If a campaign doesn't reach 10% of its goal, you choose: get your money back, or send it to the Emergency Pool.

charityMarketCap.description: One public Trust Score for every charity: donor ratings, receipts delivered on time, campaigns that reached their goal. The formula is open. Charities not on CHERR.IO yet are listed too.

emergencyPool.heading: Ready when help can't wait.
emergencyPool.description: Money from campaigns that fell short, and direct gifts, wait here. When an emergency strikes — a natural disaster, an urgent medical need, animals in danger — the donors who gave to the pool vote within 24 hours on which verified campaign receives it.

protection.title: How your money is protected
protection.escrowBody: Every donation waits in a locked account. Nobody — not even CHERR.IO — can send it anywhere except to {org}, back to donors, or to the Emergency Pool.
protection.thresholdBody: If less than 10% of the target is raised by the deadline, every donor can take their money back or send it to the Emergency Pool.
protection.singleBody: {org} receives the money 72 hours after the campaign ends, minus a 1% platform fee. Until then the CHERR.IO safety team can stop the payout.
protection.milestonesBody: {org} receives a third at success and the rest only after donors approve the receipts in a vote. CHERR.IO takes a 1% platform fee.
protection.pendingTitle: Paid in one go or in three steps
protection.pendingBody: How {org} is paid is set when the campaign ends: in one go after 72 hours, or in three steps approved by donors. CHERR.IO takes a 1% platform fee.

title.completed: All money has been paid out

body.ending: The deadline has passed. Anyone can finish the campaign: the contract then checks whether it reached 10% of its target.
body.awaiting-plan: CHERR.IO now sets how the money is paid out: at once, or in three payments with a donor vote before each of the last two.
body.release-wait: The money is paid out in one payment after a short safety wait, so CHERR.IO can stop it if something is wrong.
body.release-due: The safety wait is over. Anyone can now send the money to the beneficiary.
body.paying: {released} of 3 payments have been sent. Before the next one, the fundraiser shows how the money was used and donors vote.
body.voting: The fundraiser has shown how the last payment was used. Donors decide whether payment {payment} is sent. Each donor's vote counts as much as they gave.
body.vote-over: The voting time has ended. Anyone can count the votes: the contract then sends the payment or stops the campaign.
body.needs-review: Too few donors voted for a clear result. CHERR.IO checks the proof and decides; the decision is on the blockchain.
body.completed: Every payment has been sent to the beneficiary.
body.failed: Every donor can now get their money back, or send it to the Emergency Pool, as they chose when donating.
body.rejected: The money that was not paid out goes back to the donors, in proportion to what each gave, or to the Emergency Pool as they chose.

evidence.title: How the money was used
evidence.intro: Before each milestone payment the organisation shows what the previous payment paid for. The list of file fingerprints (the manifest) is recorded on the blockchain, so nothing can be swapped later.
evidence.manifestHint: Its SHA-256 equals the fingerprint above.
evidence.privateHint: Private files (invoices, contracts, medical papers) are seen only by the organisation and the CHERR.IO team. Their fingerprints are in the manifest.
